title: Safe Pro Group Wins $2.5 Million U.S. Army Prime Contract
summary: Safe Pro Group was awarded a $2.5 million U.S. Army prime contract to run its threat detection software on Anduril's Ghost-X drone to protect Abrams tanks.
body_markdown:
Safe Pro said its SI is optimized to process live video onboard a drone at the tactical edge and streams threat data directly into U.S. Army networks, including ATAK and Anduril's Lattice. The release states that the U.S. Army has selected the Ghost-X platform for intelligence, surveillance and reconnaissance (ISR) applications under its Medium Range Reconnaissance (MRR) program.


## Why It Matters for SPAI


The company described the award as its first U.S. Army prime contract. "We are honored to be awarded by the U.S. Army our first prime contract, a major milestone for SPAI that reflects our team's relentless work and dedication to building and fielding our novel SI-powered threat detection and mapping technology," said Dan Erdberg, chairman and CEO of Safe Pro Group. Daniel Leighton, General Manager of Tactical Effects at Anduril Industries, said that adding Safe Pro's threat-detection technology onto Ghost-X provides soldiers with "faster, more reliable situational awareness at the tactical edge" in support of the Army's tank survivability and reconnaissance missions.


According to the release, the software, Ground Truth Air, is trained on a dataset of more than 3.2 million drone images and over 60,200 confirmed detections collected across 40,520+ acres in Ukraine. The company noted that its statements on the contract value and the timing of order deliveries are forward-looking, and that actual results may differ materially.
